post.description: Required scopes: invitations:write + invitations:read + reviewers:read + reviewers:identity:read + reviewers:contacts:read. Request: JSON body: requestId (UUID stable for retries), emails (1–25 valid email addresses, normalized and deduplicated). Reuses live pending invitations; otherwise creates normal seven-day pending invitations and returns their invitationUrl. No email is sent. Requires an organizer or organization-admin authorizer. Same requestId and normalized email set replay the original invitation IDs; links are returned only while still pending and unexpired. Removed/consumed links are null on replay and are never recreated. Reusing requestId with different operation details returns 409. Unsupported fields/non-default filters return 400. post.description: Required scopes: assignments:write + assignments:read + papers:read + reviewers:read. Request: JSON body: requestId (UUID, stable for retries), paperId, integration-specific reviewerId, dueAt (required future ISO timestamp with UTC/offset), optional current cycleId. Only accepted conference reviewers and open current paper cycles. Same requestId and payload replay the original assignment; reuse with different payload returns 409. Normal assignment email uses this deadline; notificationWarning reports a queue failure without undoing the saved assignment. Replays do not send another email. info.title: OpenConferences Bot API
info.description: Conference-scoped reads, explicitly granted paper assignments with deadlines, and link-only reviewer invitations. Existing keys retain their original permissions. All response timestamps are UTC. Names and contacts are omitted without explicit identity/contact scopes. Review content, scores, conflict details, payments, files and other mutations are excluded. Invitation tokens appear only inside shareable invitation URLs, which require explicit invitation scopes and organizer authorization. Each read page is a consistent snapshot; different pages may observe concurrent updates. A missing historical submittedAt is null, not an estimate. Bearer credentials are shown only once by the human management API.

BotKey.description: ocbot_v1.<public-key-id>.<secret>; expires in at most 90 days. One conference per key. Never pass keys in query strings.
